visualCharacteristics.purpose: homepage City News & Events list: linked headline, one-line summary and READ MORE link per story

contentPattern.structure: one row per story: linked title (or heading) | summary | optional READ MORE link (cells may be merged into one); READ MORE defaults to the title link

reuseGuidance: Only the homepage City News & Events list. The Quick Links & Resources and Council Meetings link lists below it are default content.
